Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Specialists?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Specialists is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time for registration and interview formalities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is provided for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories and ex-servicemen as per government regulations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for a Full Time Specialist?
faq.answer: The salary for a Full Time Specialist is Rs. 1,43,524/- on a consolidated basis. This is a fixed monthly remuneration for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q4. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and two recent passport-size photographs. This includes educational certificates, experience certificates, and identity proof.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 23 vacancies announced for Full Time/Part Time Specialist and Senior Resident posts at ESIC Hospital C.B. Ganj Bareilly.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum qualification required for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for Senior Residents is a PG Degree/Diploma from a recognized university in the same discipline. For non-PG candidates, at least 2 years of working experience is necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ESIC Hospital, C.B. Ganj, Sleeper Road, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, PIN 243502.

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for the walk-in interview for Specialists is on 29 September 2026, and for Senior Residents, it is on 30 September 2026. Specific times should be confirmed from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis. Candidates will be appointed for a specific period as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official notification.
